t: KRLA BEAT - 60's Music magazine from KRLA Los Angeles
s: KRLA Beat was an American rock music magazine that operated between 1964 and 1968. It began in October 1964 as a free newsletter distributed by the Southern Californian radio station KRLA, before being reworked as a more reportage-focused title in February 1965. Publication ceased in May of 1968.
